entities.summary: The Kusumba Mosque is a mosque, located in the village of Kusumba, in Manda Upazila, Naogaon District, in the Rajshahi Division of Bangladesh. It was completed in 1559, the mosque is one of Bangladesh's national heritages sites. The mosque is often nicknamed "The Black Gem of Bangladesh".
